form.token_hint: A personal access token from GitHub, GitLab or similar. It is stored encrypted and never shown again; the runner sends it over HTTPS to the repository's host only.

form.token_username_hint: Optional. GitHub accepts any value; the default is x-access-token. Bitbucket needs your username.
